posts.subject: Apology from OxygeN
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dear Community.


As you might already know guys I have done something terrible yesterday I have been kicked out of the team simply for my reason, I have kicked @Mas0n from the teamspeak twice ( once in private and once in talk with @Nachtfrische ) I understand that this was totally disrespectful but me and mason talked later to each other and explained it to each other, but this also had a negative impact on me because I showed no respect later to Nachtfrische when he tried to talk to me I constantly left when he wanted to talk to me first and explain it and get this clear but I kept leaving ( this showed a critical disrespect ) and I feel bad about this, I did not mean to be rude or be disrespectful, also talking about what I talked and posted on forum yesterday.


"It's you that kinda made a too fast decision."


- I took it too far by saying this, your decision's are never are taken too fast you usually take your time with the decision but you also know what's correct more for the community to stop further harm from happening, I feel like this has made this even worse but your decisions are always 100% correct you just did not want me to due make further harm by possibly abusing admin on the server or making the admin team look horrible after what I said on forum myself when having the admin rank.


"YOU DID NOT GAVE ME A CHOICE"


- I just did not think of what I was saying, I just wrote what came from my mind but it's possibly after people even hyped this up by saying that this decision was made were taken too fast, I regret saying this as this made the leaders look bad but I don't want the community to think of leaders in negative way, you guys are putting 100% effort into the community as soon as there is more than enough time and most of the day which is trying to fix stuff on server and looking onto how this can be improved.


"people said that this decision is BULL SHIT."


- This is worst thing I have done which is saying that the decision was bad, It was actually correct what Nachtfrische did and I should have not messaged some admin's and close friends of dream in steam private message as this made the leader team look afoul but I did not mean it to make you guys look bad I just wrote to people I trust that will not spread this around, yep I still did the wrong thing and I agree more than 100% with the punishment.


"Nachtfrische never messaged me about being inactive"


- I disagree here what I said you talked to about my activity as test-admin and I even agree that my activity was terrible and it should have been better but at that moment I was not full of time and I agree that most of my activity was terrible but I'm constantly trying to work on this on daily basis trying to be active for at least for more than 2+ hours, but usually this not happens and I can't connect due to life reasons but I can promise that this will change and I will work on it since day one of happening.




I hope I will be able to comeback to the admin team to prove my commitment and show that I'm more than suitable for this position, the thing I wrote yesterday got out of control fast and that I and other were hyping it up did not make it better but actually made it worse for myself right now, I don't want to waste my last chance I was given in 23.08.2016 where Nachtfrische stated that this is my "final chance and to use it" I also don't want to let down other people that have given me the chance to become admin that day also I wanna carry on the support I was giving people when being a test-admin or admin, even today when calladmin's were coming through I still handled them even tho I should not because I technically was not a admin anymore but I did not want rule breakers or cheaters to get away without any punishment, I applied as a admin to support and not break I still wanna show this and I hope I will be granted the really final chance, I will for sure not let anyone down and I will not connect or try to stay calm after having a bad day, or when getting angry I will just disconnect to not make any stupid decisions that will impact me on later run in community or possibly harm the community itself, the talk we had today just showed me how much bad I did yesterday and how little I have through that day, the admin position for me in dream is something special because I can help and bring the correct enjoyment and stop rule breakers.



Kind Regards


OxygeN

You put @Nachtfrische in a very bad situation, now you say, it was just a lie? Not only is that disgusting, it`s a slander. Really.
I hope you talk to @Nachtfrische and clear things out, private talk. In Germany its a way of saying youre sorry and taking responsability.


I`m really disappointed.


Passing bye

I understand what you mean @ifZ4ne and I agree with you on what you said and that it's horrible, I gave emotions take over me and I realized it after what happened later the talk with @Nachtfrische has shown a lot to me and what @Mas0n said as he was there is more than 100% real and I hope I get the chance to show that this will not happen again, I promise it to you and @Nachtfrische and whole of the community to not let you guy's never more.

Hello @OxygeN,


we've read your apology and decided against granting you another chance.
The decision was made unanimously by the higher admins and leader team at Dream.


Although we appreciate you apologizing and clarifying ambiguities, we simply can't glance over the mistakes you did. As an administrator, you are not supposed to get influenced or misled by other people and should always stay focussed and collected. Talking about the community and lying about other points just to apologize a day later does not seem like something a good administrator would do.
We currently do not see the benefits of you being part of the admin team or you enriching it in any way.


Therefore, we must reject your "reapplication".
However, we're hoping that, regardless of the outcome, you'll stay a part of the community.


[abgelehnt-new*]
